LanguageData.RavenCentralAbility_NeuralResonance.desc: Uses the Sunlit Nexus to maintain a short-cycle neural resonance in colonists across the map, improving their learning and movement speeds.
LanguageData.RavenCentralAbility_RavenConstructionRes: Connects completed Raven buildings into a collective neural network. This protocol dynamically selects the highest supported tier based on your building count, boosting colonist work speed, learning, movement, and consciousness.
Continuously compresses Raven industrial control cycles. Higher levels fully override lower-level speed, power, and fuel settings.
LanguageData.RavenCentralAbility_IndustrialAbsolutePr: Connects every Raven industrial building to the nexus protection layer. While active, all connected production machines, pipes, and ports become completely invulnerable to damage.
LanguageData.RavenCentralAbility_SlotExpansion.label: [Raven] Protocol Slot Expansion
LanguageData.RavenCentralAbility_SlotExpansion.descri: Expands the Sunlit Nexus protocol bus. Each unlocked level permanently adds one global ability slot.
